[package]
workspace = "../../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-dsl-record"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"
id = "dsl-record"

[lints]
workspace = true

[lib]
name = "semio_framework_dsl_record"
path = "../../🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-dsl = { path = "../../../📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../../🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-diagnostic = { path = "../../../../⚠️diagnostic/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-pack-json = { path = "../../../../🎒️pack/🔤️json/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }

[dev-dependencies]
semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../../⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-dsl-record-derive = { path = "../../✨️derive/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
serde_json = { version = "1.0", features = ["float_roundtrip"] }

[[test]]
name = "field_refusal_public"
path = "../../🧪️tests/🪆️refusal/🚪️public/🦀️.rs"

[package]
workspace = "../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-dsl"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Product-neutral lexical tokens, explicit grammar recognition, protocol walking and registered idiom interfaces."

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"
id = "dsl"

[lints]
workspace = true

[lib]
name = "semio_framework_dsl"
path = "🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-async = { path = "../../../⏳️async/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-diagnostic = { path = "../../../⚠️diagnostic/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }

[dev-dependencies]
semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
serde_json = "1.0.140"

[[test]]
name = "lexical-public"
path = "../../🧪️tests/🚪️public/🦀️.rs"

[[test]]
name = "carrier-record-lists"
path = "../../🧪️tests/🧪️carrier-record-lists/🦀️.rs"

[package]
workspace = "../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-value"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Neutral typed value conversion, ordered ownership, bounded retained cloning and explicit retirement."

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"
id = "value"

[lints]
workspace = true

[lib]
name = "semio_framework_value"
path = "🦀️.rs"

[features]
default = []
ordered-set-serde = []

[dependencies]
semio-framework-value-derive = { path = "../../✨️derive/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-io-base64 = { path = "../../../🚪️io/🔤️base64/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.140"

[package]
workspace = "../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-diagnostic"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Canonical neutral source spans, bounded text errors and structured fault diagnostics."

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"
id = "diagnostic"

[lints]
workspace = true

[lib]
name = "semio_framework_diagnostic"
path = "🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.140"

[package]
workspace = "../../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-pack-json"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Owned JSON syntax, ordered values, explicit member authority and controlled native serialization."

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"
id = "pack-json"

[lints]
workspace = true

[lib]
name = "semio_framework_pack_json"
path = "../../🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../../🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }

[dev-dependencies]
serde_json = { version = "1.0.140", features = ["float_roundtrip"] }
